name: Scroll of Summon Weak Daemon
description: Summons a weeping imp that deals 1d4 damage alongside you for 1d4 fights.

name: Scroll: Palms Open the Southern Gate
description: Invokes the sulfurous breach to deal 1d6+1 unblockable damage (1d4 uses).

name: Scroll: Aegis of Sorrow
description: Woven despair that absorbs 1d4 damage when hit by monsters (1d4 uses).

name: Scroll: False Omen
description: Shattered prophecy: choose any room outcome or reroll any single die (1 use).
